Ashgrove: \(8,837 \div 24 = 368.21\) pupils per school.  
Millbrook: \(5,562 \div 15 = 370.80\) pupils per school.  
Difference: \(370.80 - 368.21 = 2.59\) pupils per school, so Millbrook is higher.

ANSWER: Millbrook | 2.59

Ashgrove: 8,837 ÷ 24 = 368.21 pupils per school.

Difference: 370.80 − 368.21 = 2.59 pupils per school.

ANSWER: Millbrook | 2.59
